title: Menyasszonyként vágott bele a fogyókúrába, 50 kilóval könnyebben mondta ki az igent
content:
Menyasszonyként vágott bele a fogyókúrába, 50 kilóval könnyebben mondta ki az igent
Emilie Heeks egyetlen nagy célt tűzött ki maga elé, szerette volna magabiztosabban érezni magát a testében, mielőtt lefoglalja az esküvője időpontját. A 26 éves brit menyasszony januárban kezdett életmódot váltani, és végül körülbelül ötven kilogrammot fogyott.
Emilie egy bevásárló áruházban dolgozik, és nagyjából 113 kilogrammos testsúllyal csatlakozott egy helyi edzés csoporthoz. Szerette volna jobban érezni magát a bőrében, és eljutni oda, hogy magabiztosan tervezhesse a nagy napját. Tudatosan döntött úgy, hogy nem használ fogyókúrás injekciókat. Úgy gondolta, hogy hosszú távon így is, úgy is meg kell tanulnia, hogyan étkezzen, és hogyan érezze jól magát ilyenek nélkül.
Ezért inkább az életmódváltásra, a számára fenntartható étkezési szokásokra és a fokozatos fogyásra helyezte a hangsúlyt. A célja nem egy gyors megoldás volt, hanem az, hogy olyan változtatásokat alakítson ki, amelyekhez később is tud tartani magát. Az egész végül az esküvőjén teljesedett ki, a képeken már a nagy napján látható, magabiztosan és boldogan.

title: Après plus de 15 ans d’absence, le comité “Esca’fête” fait revivre la ducasse d’Escanaffles ces 25, 26 et 27 septembre
content:
Après plus de 15 ans d'absence, le comité "Esca'fête" fait revivre la ducasse d'Escanaffles ces 25, 26 et 27 septembre
Après quinze ans d'absence, la ducasse fera son grand retour à Escanaffles, ce week-end. Durant trois jours, du vendredi 25 au dimanche 27 septembre, le village cellois renouera avec ses anciennes traditions festives à travers un programme entièrement gratuit.
- Publié le 21-09-2026 à 17h01
La nostalgie des ducasses de village… Quinze ans que les Escanafflois attendaient de pouvoir revivre ces moments festifs et conviviaux. Ce week-end, leur ducasse fera enfin son grand retour, avec trois jours de festivités entièrement gratuites.
"La ducasse occupait autrefois une place importante dans la vie locale, relève le comité Esca'Fêtes. Escanaffles en accueillait même trois chaque année, deux en juillet et l'autre en septembre."
Ducasse des Trentenaires, ducasse du Joncquois ou encore foire artisanale : autant de rendez-vous qui ont marqué la mémoire des habitants, et évoquent de nombreux souvenirs aux participants de ces festivités d'antan…
Depuis 2010, pourtant, plus aucune ducasse n'était organisée dans le village de l'entité de Celles. La disparition récente du club de football local a également marqué un tournant dans la vie associative d'Escanaffles. Mais certains anciens membres ont souhaité poursuivre leur engagement autrement.
"Une grande partie des personnes qui faisaient vivre le club ont souhaité continuer à animer leur village autrement. L'idée de recréer une grande fête populaire au cœur d'Escanaffles s'est rapidement imposée comme la meilleure façon de prolonger cette dynamique", explique le comité, qui a ainsi vu le jour sous le nom d'Esca'Fêtes.
L'objectif est de faire de cette nouvelle ducasse un rendez-vous porté par l'ensemble du village. "Elle doit devenir la ducasse de tous les Escanafflois. Notre volonté est de fédérer les habitants, les associations, l'école, les commerçants et les bénévoles autour d'un événement commun."
Les festivités débuteront ce vendredi 25 septembre à 18 h, avec un afterwork et une exposition de photographies anciennes du village, réalisée par les élèves de l'école communale. La soirée se poursuivra avec DJ Alex.
Samedi après-midi, place au FestiKids, avec de nombreuses activités pour les enfants : châteaux gonflables, grimage, jeux anciens. Après un repas "cochon à la broche", le groupe "À peu près ça" se produira à partir de 21 h pour un concert mêlant rock et humour.
La marche ADEPS (5, 10, 15 et 20 km) de l'école communale lancera les festivités du dimanche 27 septembre. À 11 h, le groupe "Dans Ton Cuivre" animera l'apéritif musical. À partir de 14 h, le traditionnel jeu de bourle fera son retour autour du village.

title: Six Red and White Cooperative outlets completed in Central Papua
content:
Colonel Inf. Fajar Wibawa Angkasa, head of the territorial section at the 173/PVB Regional Military Command, said on Saturday that four of the completed outlets were in Nabire Regency and two in Mimika Regency.
The Indonesian military, or TNI, was tasked with carrying out the physical construction of the KDMP outlets as part of its support for the government program, Angkasa said.
In Nabire, construction is under way at seven locations. Four outlets have been completed, while work at the other three has reached more than 95 percent completion.
In Mimika, construction of the two planned outlets has been completed, he said.
The number of locations could increase, with four potential sites identified in Nabire and three in Mimika, although construction at those sites will depend on whether requirements are met and land is ready, Angkasa said.
According to Angkasa, technical considerations in determining locations include the availability of at least 600 square meters of land and electricity capacity of at least 5,500 watts
Population size is also considered when selecting locations to ensure the cooperatives have a sufficient community base to support their operations.
“Essentially, there is one KDMP in each village. But we first look at the population situation, because there must be at least 500 households. We will prioritize areas with higher population density first,” Angkasa said.
Lieutenant Colonel Arh. Dwi Palwanto Tirta Mentari, commander of the 1705/Nabire Military District Command, said further preparations were needed before the facilities could begin full operations.
Completion of the buildings would not immediately mean full management would be handed over to cooperative administrators, as they would first receive assistance to prepare for operations, he said.
The assistance is planned to cover administrative management, supply chains, sales, and efforts to improve the capacity of cooperative administrators, he added.
Ministry of Cooperatives data shows that a total of 24,701 KDMPs had completed physical development by Sept. 14, with construction still ongoing for 10,866 others.

Η Κίνα δηλώνει έτοιμη να υπερασπιστεί τα "νόμιμα συμφέροντα" του Ιράν
Ενθαρρύνει την Ισλαμική Δημοκρατία και τις ΗΠΑ να επιδείξουν "λογική" και "αυτοσυγκράτηση"
Η Λευκορωσία απελευθέρωσε 25 πολιτικούς κρατουμένους με αντάλλαγμα την άρση αμερικανικών κυρώσεων σε βάρος δύο επιχειρήσεων της χώρας, που είναι σύμμαχος της Μόσχας, ανακοίνωσε σήμερα από το Μινσκ ο απεσταλμένος του Λευκού Οίκου Τζον Κόουλ.
Η χώρα έχει προχωρήσει στην απελευθέρωση εκατοντάδων προσώπων τα τελευταία χρόνια, μετά την επανέναρξη του διαλόγου με την Ουάσινγκτον, που ξεκίνησε έπειτα από την επιστροφή του Ντόναλντ Τραμπ στην προεδρία των ΗΠΑ. Εκατοντάδες άλλοι παραμένουν φυλακισμένοι μετά τις μαζικές διαδηλώσεις του 2020. Η Viesna, μία από τις κορυφαίες οργανώσεις ανθρωπίνων δικαιωμάτων της Λευκορωσίας, αναφέρει ότι η χώρα εξακολουθεί να έχει στη φυλακή 886 πολιτικούς κρατούμενους.
"Η δέσμευση του προέδρου Τραμπ υπέρ της άμεσης διπλωματίας αποδίδει καρπούς. Σας ευχαριστώ, κύριε πρόεδρε Λουκασένκο, για αυτήν την πρωτοβουλία και ευχαριστούμε τους Λιθουανούς φίλους μας για την υποστήριξή τους", τόνισε ο Κόουλ με ανάρτηση στο Χ, που συνοδεόταν μαζί με μια φωτογραφία που δείχνει μια ομάδα ανδρών και γυναικών, υποδηλώνοντας ότι αυτοί έφτασαν στη Λιθουανία.
Σύμφωνα με την Viesna, ο δημοσιογράφος Αντρέι Αλεξάντροφ, ακτιβιστές ανθρωπίνων δικαιωμάτων και η πολιτική επιστήμονας Τατιάνα Κουζίνα ήταν μεταξύ αυτών που απελευθερώθηκαν.
Ο απεσταλμένος της Ουάσινγκτον διαβεβαίωσε ότι εργάζονται για να "εξασφαλίσουν την απελευθέρωση και άλλων στο πολύ κοντινό μέλλον".
Λευκορώσος αξιωματούχος διευκρίνισε ότι δύο επιχειρήσεις από τις οποίες θα αρθούν οι κυρώσεις είναι η εταιρία χρωμάτων Lakokraska και η εταιρία παραγωγής ξύλου και επίπλων Bellesbumprom.

title: In Allahabad High Court: Illegal detention, Rs 50,000 payout and praise for police officer
content:
4 min readNew DelhiSep 21, 2026 05:26 PM IST

Praising a senior Uttar Pradesh police officer for admitting an “error” on the part of the police over a man’s illegal detention in August, the Allahabad High Court has awarded Rs 50,000 compensation to the man and ordered his release.
“…this Court wishes to record its appreciation for the candour with which Mr. Vivek Chandra Yadav, Deputy Commissioner of Police has disclosed unequivocally in his affidavit without trying to beat around the bush and accepting the error on the part of the police without any ambiguity,” the court said.
A division bench of Justices Atul Sreedharan and Achal Sachdev passed the order on September 18 while hearing a habeas corpus petition filed by a man, who alleged that he had been illegally detained by the police.




“This Court unhesitatingly holds that the petitioner was held in illegal custody from 15.08.2026 till he was produced before the Magistrate and sent to judicial remand on 19.08.2026,” the order read.
Justices Atul Sreedharan and Achal Sachdev passed the order on September 18 while hearing a habeas corpus petition filed by a man.
According to the plea, the petitioner was allegedly picked up from his shop by two armed policemen on August 15. The court had earlier sought the personal affidavit of the Superintendent of Police after reference was made to CCTV footage of the incident.
The Deputy Commissioner of Police, in his affidavit, told the court that the petitioner had a property dispute with his neighbour, who levelled a serious allegation against him of being a citizen of Bangladesh and filed a police complaint against the petitioner. The high court made it clear that it was not examining the merits of those allegations and was concerned only with the legality of his custody.
It was further stated in the affidavit that the petitioner was picked up from his medical shop on August 15 and sent to jail on August 19. The deputy commissioner of police told the court that the Station House Officer and the investigating officer had failed to give a satisfactory explanation for the petitioner’s detention from August 15. Both officers were suspended on September 17 for gross negligence.
Story continues below this ad
The SHO claimed that he had instructed two constables to ask the petitioner to report to the police station, but they misunderstood the instructions and took him along with them. The SHO also said that he had been away from the police station on August 15 following a firing incident in the area.
The court thus held that the petitioner had been kept in illegal custody from August 15 until his production before the magistrate and subsequent remand on August 19. It ordered that he be released forthwith, unless he was wanted in any other case. The court clarified that the order would not prevent the State from arresting him again if necessary, provided the procedure established by law was followed.
The bench further directed the State to pay Rs 50,000 as compensation for the illegal detention. The amount is to be recovered from those found responsible after an inquiry.
The court appreciated the Deputy Commissioner of Police for acknowledging the police error and directed that the officer’s conduct be placed on his service record. It similarly appreciated the SHO’s disclosure of the circumstances leading to the illegal detention.
Story continues below this ad
“The Court hopes that the police would take cognizance and carry out corrective measures in future, so that such incidents may not happen, while the requirement of an accused in the investigative process is also fulfilled and his constitutional rights are also taken into cognizance,” the order read.

NEW DELHI: Around 93% of those whose cases have been decided so far over not being able to vote in the West Bengal polls this year because of doubts raised about their eligibility during Election Commission's SIR drive have won their appeals and have been included in the electoral roll. However, 8,649 of 1.2 lakh lost their appeal and will be deleted.The numbers, mentioned in an annexure to an affidavit filed by EC in Supreme Court, showed that 1,13,943 could satisfy the tribunals that the commission's decision to exclude them from the roll was incorrect, and this may intensify criticism of the poll panel.Curiously, while the affidavit - filed to counter the claim of TMC and its MP, Derek O'Brien, that the exclusions cost them 31 assembly seats - puts the number of cases decided until Sept 16 at 1,26,194, the annexure stated that 1,22,592 were decided by the 24 tribunals until Sept 10.EC sources, however, said the number of disposed of cases was too low to be seen as representative of the final outcome of all cases. They also said the results might favour inclusion because cases where citizens had documentary proof were decided first.The annexure also mentioned district-wise filing of appeals by voters and disposal of cases. The appellate tribunals were set up on SC's direction that panels comprising former HC chief justices and judges would hear appeals against exclusions in the roll revision process.
A person whose claim for inclusion was rejected could approach the tribunals, which had started hearing appeals in April.Claiming that O'Brien had misled the court, EC said, "It is pertinent to note that the applicant has conspicuously ignored the other side of the very same data relied upon by it. As disclosed in the applicant's own application, in as many as 21 constituencies, the number of deletions under adjudication exceeds the margin of victory of the candidates belonging to the applicant's own party."The affidavit said that applying the very same test and reasoning propounded by the applicant, "the applicant would, therefore, equally have to seek setting aside of the election results in those constituencies won by its own party candidates".
"The selective and inconsistent application of an inherently flawed and speculative yardstick, therefore, exposes the self-serving and mala fide nature of the present application," it said.EC said the attempt to portray all deletions as "effective disenfranchisement" was wholly incorrect and misleading. "It is humbly submitted that even assuming, without admitting, the correctness of the figures relied upon by the applicant, once the removals pertaining to ineligible ASDD (absent, shifted, duplicate/dead, and demoted/displaced) entries are excluded, the applicant's own data demonstrates that in several constituencies, the number of adjud-icated deletions is lower than the margin of defeat," it said.This data, therefore, "completely demolished" the "speculative theory that the adjudication exercise altered the electoral outcome," the affidavit said.

title: SPO disengaged over ‘fake’ records, Jammu and Kashmir High Court orders reinstatement
content:
4 min readNew DelhiSep 24, 2026 03:30 PM IST

The Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court has quashed the disengagement of a special police officer (SPO) accused of furnishing fake documents to conceal his age, holding that he was removed without a show-cause notice or inquiry.
Dealing with the SPO’s plea, Justice M A Chowdhary said the action violated natural justice and ordered his reinstatement, along with related benefits.
“The irrefutable conclusion that could be drawn is that the respondents indeed have violated the basic fundamental principle of natural justice, while ordering disengagement of the services of the Petitioner as SPO, thereby condemning him unheard,” the ruling observed.




The court added that the respondents proceeded against the petitioner, raising a seriou accusation, for which he was required to be heard in his defence.
SPOs denied constable conversion
The petitioner claimed to have been engaged as an SPO in the department in 2004. In 2007, the department started a process for the conversion of SPOs to constables on compassionate grounds. According to the petitioner, he, along with five other SPOs, was not considered for conversion to constables despite recommendations by the competent authority.
Justice M A Chowdhary observed that the petitioner was disengaged from service without issuing a show-cause notice or conducting an inquiry.
In 2011, the petitioner and the five other SPOs approached the high court which directed the authorities in 2012 to consider their appointment and absorption as constable drivers. The direction was upheld by a division bench in 2013.
While facing contempt proceedings, the authorities in May 2022 absorbed him and nine other SPOs as constables. He later noticed that his date of birth had been incorrectly recorded as March 4, 1981, instead of January 1, 1973. Although he informed the police authorities about the error, the correction was not made.
Story continues below this ad
Instead, the senior superintendent of police (security), Kashmir, passed an order on December 21, 2023, disengaging him from service. The authorities alleged that he had used fake and fabricated documents to conceal his actual age at the time of his SPO engagement and that he was over the prescribed age limit.
The petitioner challenged the disengagement before the high court, contending that the authorities had removed him without issuing a show-cause notice or conducting an inquiry.
Representing the state, Additional Advocate General Mohsin-ul-Showkat Qadri argued that the petitioner wilfully produced fake and fabricated documents to suppress his actual age with an ill design.
No prior notice: Order
The court observed that the respondents disengaged the petitioner without issuing a show-cause notice or conducting an inquiry prior to taking adverse action. The basic legal requirement that no person should be condemned unheard was completely ignored.
Story continues below this ad
The court noted that terminating or disengaging an employee based on serious, stigmatic allegations (such as submitting fake/fabricated documents) requires providing the individual with notice and a reasonable opportunity to present their defence before any punishment is imposed.
“From the perusal of the relevant record made available before this court by the respondents, nothing is forthcoming as to fact that the respondents have issued any prior notice to the petitioner or conducted any enquiry before disengaging the services of the petitioner,” the order said.
It emphasised that the petitioner was entitled to be afforded an opportunity of hearing before inflicting the major punishment of disengagement from service.

title: SP u džudu za veterane: Prva medalja za BiH, Evropljanima svih 18 zlata
content:
SP u džudu za veterane: Prva medalja za BiH, Evropljanima svih 18 zlata
Današnji dan donio je i veliko slavlje za domaću publiku jer je Bosna i Hercegovina stigla do prve medalje na ovom takmičenju. Bosnu i Hercegovinu danas je predstavljalo devet takmičara: Hasan Mehić, Avdo Bešić, Zijad Sejdinović, Milanko Mučibabić, Nikola Kljajić, Arif Libić, Elvir Salihagić, Zikret Hasanica i Dragan Božović.
Junak dana za našu reprezentaciju bio je Mučibabić, koji je u kategoriji veterana M9 do 100 kilograma osvojio srebrnu medalju. Na putu do finala Mučibabić je bio bolji od rivala iz Francuske, Velike Britanije i Rusije, dok mu je najsjajnije odličje izmaklo porazom od reprezentativca Kube Luisa Torresa Cobasa.
Finalne borbe ponudile su vrhunski džudo, a dominantnu ulogu imali su evropski takmičari kojima su pripale sve zlatne medalje današnjeg programa.
Najuspješnija je bila Njemačka sa tri osvojena zlata, dok su po dvije zlatne medalje izborili predstavnici Austrije, Rusije, Rumunije i Francuske. Po jedno najsjajnije odličje otišlo je u Moldaviju, Brazil, Hrvatsku, Španiju, Češku, Švedsku i Nizozemsku.
Nakon četvrtog takmičarskog dana došlo je i do promjena na vrhu tabelarnog poretka. Gruzija je zadržala vodeću poziciju sa devet zlatnih medalja, na drugo mjesto se probila Francuska sa sedam, dok je treća Rusija sa šest. Po pet zlatnih odličja u dosadašnjem toku takmičenja sakupili su Brazil i Kazahstan.
Podsjećamo, ovo jedno od najmasovnijih takmičenja u organizaciji Džudo saveza Bosne i Hercegovine okuplja 1.350 takmičara iz 65 zemalja.
Nakon završetka veteranskih borbi, vikend u Areni Hills rezervisan je za takmičenje u katama i Specijalnu olimpijadu, a ulaz za sve ljubitelje džuda i dalje je besplatan.

title: Year after Vadodara bridge collapse killed 22, new link on Mahi River opens today
content:
Over a year after the Gambhira-Mujpur bridge collapse that killed 22 people in Vadodara district, a new bridge alongside the remains of the broken structure is ready for launch. Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel is expected to inaugurate the new 868.75-metre bridge, which has epoxy-coated steel for better durability, on Sunday, officials said.
Built in 12 months with 23 spans and 21 piers, the new bridge will restore a direct route between Vadodara’s Padra taluka and Anklav in Anand district, an official of the Roads and Buildings Department (R&B) told The Indian Express. As per the R&B department, the bridge construction began on August 14, 2025, and was completed on August 13, 2026 — making it the “fastest” river bridge to be constructed in the state.
Alongside the new bridge, the steel-girder span of the old structure, which was built in 1985, still stands on the Mahi River, also called Mahisagar locally. On July 9 last year, a slab between two piers of the concrete bridge gave way during peak morning traffic hours, plunging vehicles into the river. The bridge would see an average of one lakh vehicles, mostly heavy-duty ones, plying it daily.
The new bridge has been constructed at an estimated overall expenditure of Rs 278 crore, as per the project details shared by the R&B department. Although the project had an “administrative sanction” of Rs 212 crore and a “technical sanction” of Rs 244.16 crore. The construction tender was awarded to the Patan-based Shree Manglam Buildcon Pvt Ltd for Rs 173.56 crore.
The state government attributed the pace of the project partly to “close monitoring by the CMO”, in a statement on Saturday. The note stated that the CM reviewed the progress of the bridge with the R&B Department secretary every fortnight over the past year, sought progress reports and intervened to prevent delays, after granting “administrative approval” to the new bridge within a fortnight of the July 2025 collapse.
The collapse also left students and employees travelling between Padra and Anklav reeling. As an interim measure, the government sanctioned Rs 9 crore for a steel structure on the old bridge to allow two-wheelers to cross. After the temporary arrangement, the old bridge was opened in April this year.
The R&B officials said the new bridge presented its own construction challenges, particularly fluctuations in Mahisagar’s water level and flow. Despite these conditions, the 23 piers were erected, and the structure was completed within the prescribed period. They said that 300 workers were deployed on the project round the clock. The bridge incorporates epoxy-coated steel to reduce the risk of corrosion and improve durability. Officials said precast elements were used to accelerate construction. Inspection platforms have been provided at each pier to facilitate checks of the structure.
Story continues below this ad
“Given the circumstances in which the previous bridge collapsed, safety testing was a significant part of the final stage of the project. Each of the 23 spans was subjected to a 280-tonne load test to assess its capacity. Vibration monitoring and pull-out tests were also conducted, while officials and consultants carried out physical inspections of the bridge’s components,” an R&B official said.
The pull-out test was carried out to assess the strength of the concrete and the grip of reinforcement steel and anchor bolts, while vibration monitoring used sensors to measure the bridge’s response to movement and controlled loads. Officials from the R&B department’s Design Circle, along with a deputy executive engineer and consultants, carried out the physical inspection before Sunday’s opening. “There was no compromise on the construction. This will ensure that commuters using the bridge feel safe,” the official said.
Once opened, the new bridge will restore a direct link for commuters travelling between Vadodara, Padra and Anand, ending the 45-km detour that has been a mandatory consequence of the bridge collapse last year.

title: Pilotprojekt in Pankow erleichtert Wohnungslosen die Wahlteilnahme
content: Ein Pilotprojekt in Pankow bringt Verwaltung und soziale Einrichtungen zusammen und unterstützt Wohnungslose direkt vor Ort bei der Anmeldung und bei der Stimmabgabe. Eine eigene Wohnung braucht es nicht, um in Berlin mitzubestimmen. Auch Menschen ohne festen Wohnsitz dürfen bei der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus am 20. September ihre Stimme abgeben. Doch das Wählen ist für viele Menschen ohne festen Wohnsitz mit Hürden verbunden. Im Rahmen eines Pilotprojekts im Bezirk Pankow helfen Mitarbeitende des Bezirks, der Diakonie, der Immanuel-Beratung und der Landesarmutskonferenz wohnungslosen Menschen direkt in einer Tagesstätte der Diakonie. Da Menschen ohne festen Wohnsitz nicht automatisch im Wählerverzeichnis stehen, müssen sie sich für die Wahl anmelden. Dabei bekommen sie vor Ort Unterstützung. Verwaltung und Sozialarbeit arbeiten zusammen Wer möchte, kann anschließend sogar direkt per Briefwahl abstimmen. Für die Diakonie ist das Projekt ein wichtiger Beitrag zur gesellschaftlichen Teilhabe. Es zeigt, wie Verwaltung und soziale Einrichtungen gemeinsam Hürden abbauen können. Das Wahlamt sorgt für ein rechtssicheres Verfahren, während die Sozialarbeit den direkten Zugang zu den Menschen ermöglicht. Gerade für Menschen ohne festen Wohnsitz kann dieser persönliche Kontakt entscheidend sein. Denn viele wissen laut Bundesarbeitsgemeinschaft Wohnungslosenhilfe gar nicht, dass sie wählen dürfen oder welche Schritte dafür nötig sind. Eine Stimme, die zählt Grundsätzlich gelten für Menschen ohne festen Wohnsitz dieselben Voraussetzungen wie für andere Wahlberechtigte. Sie müssen Deutsche und mindestens 16 Jahre alt sein und seit mindestens drei Monaten in Berlin leben. Das Projekt macht deutlich: Demokratie soll nicht davon abhängen, ob jemand eine feste Adresse hat. Mit praktischer Unterstützung kann politische Teilhabe für mehr Menschen erreichbar werden. title: „Krone“-Vereinsserie - Bis auf Olympia hat dieser Klub alles erlebt
content:
Die Möve Salzburg gibt es schon seit 1923. In dieser langen Zeit hat der Ruderverein sehr viel erlebt. Nach dem 2. Weltkrieg wurde dieser vor dem Land Salzburg befreit. Im Küstenrudern hat man aktuell Hoffnungsträger.
Kaum ein Sportverein in Salzburg hat eine solche Geschichte wie der Ruderklub Möve Salzburg. Gegründet hat sich der Verein am 10. Februar 1923, das erste Bootshaus wurde an der Salzach im Bereich des heutigen Aya-Bades errichtet. „Angeblich“, erzählt Ehrenpräsident Gottfried Eisinger, „hat man den Verein so benannt, weil es damals so viele Möwen an der Salzach gegeben hat.“ Bald stellten die Gründer um Fritz Wonka fest, dass der Fluss für einen Ruderbetrieb ungeeignet war, so übersiedelte man an den Wallersee und blieb bis heute dort.
Danach wurde es turbulent: Im Anschlussjahr 1938 wurde die Möve in den nationalsozialistischen Reichsbund für Leibesübungen eingegliedert. Das Ende des Zweiten Weltkrieges war auch ein Ende des Rudervereins, weil er als Vereinsvermögen von den Alliierten beschlagnahmt wurde. „Die Möve war die erste Institution, die von den Amerikanern befreit worden ist, noch bevor Salzburg befreit wurde“, erklärt Eisinger.
Jahr für Jahr feierte die Möve Salzburg Erfolge
Danach begann für den Klub der Wiederaufbau. Die erste Herbstregatta 1951 am Wallersee war mit mehr als 100 Teilnehmern einer der größten Sportevents in der Nachkriegszeit in Salzburg. In den 70er Jahren begann die Arbeit von Professor Dietmar Mühlfellner Früchte zu tragen. Jahr für Jahr feierte die Möve Erfolge (1975 waren es 96 Vereinssiege).
1995 übernahm Eisinger die Leitung des Leistungszentrums. Mit Ralph Kreibich ging daraus das bislang größte Möve-Talent hervor, das sich 2007 im Einer zum Europameister krönte. Mit der Gründung des Küstenruderns und dem EM-Titel von Tabea Minichmayr 2024 sowie dem Junioren-WM-Titel 2025 von Nikolas Roidmayer mit Caroline Schwendinger setzt der Verein, dessen rund 155 Mitglieder pro Jahr gesamt bis zu 40.000 Kilometer rudern, hier seine Erfolge fort. Doch Eisinger weiß, was in dieser bemerkenswerten Geschichte fehlt: „Von der Möve war noch nie jemand bei Olympia.“

title: Farmers end indefinite stir in Kurugodu after officials assure water to D7 canal
content:
Farmers withdrew their overnight and indefinite protest near the Irrigation Department office in Kurugodu, Ballari district, on Saturday after officials assured them that water would be supplied to the tail-end areas of the D7 canal.
The protest, which had entered its second day, was launched by farmers demanding adequate water for irrigation as they prepare for sowing and to protect the standing crops. The farmers had insisted that at least 600 cusecs of water be released into the D7 canal until the onset of the next spell of rain.
An executive engineer from Ballari arrived at the protest site around 9 p.m. on Friday and held discussions with the farmers on the release of water. The talks initially failed to break the deadlock, with the farmers refusing to withdraw their agitation.
The farmers said they had lost confidence in assurances given by officials during an earlier protest on September 2, as the commitments made then had not been fulfilled. They demanded that the government immediately ensure the required quantity of water in the canal, particularly to enable water to reach villages and farms at the tail end of the system.
On Saturday, the assistant executive engineer of the taluk Irrigation Department held discussions with senior officials in the presence of departmental official Supreeth and assured the farmers that steps would be taken to ensure that water reached farmers in every village, including those at the tail end of the canal.
Following the assurance, the farmers called off their agitation.

title: Kyrgyz citizens who worked in Korea receive lump-sum payments
content:
Citizens of the Kyrgyz Republic who were officially employed in South Korea—and from whose wages pension contributions were deducted—receive lump-sum payments upon returning to their home country.
According to the Social Fund, 151 individuals have so far applied for receiving a lump-sum payout of their accumulated pension funds from the National Pension Service of the Republic of Korea. Of these, 126 citizens have already been approved for and received payment, while 25 are awaiting a decision.
The average lump-sum payment amounted to $3,789.

title: Clinical outcomes of individualized surgical pathways in elderly patients with spinal tuberculosis: a retrospective cohort study in eastern China
content: ObjectiveAlthough surgical indications for adult spinal tuberculosis (TB) are well established, optimal surgical strategies for elderly patients remain uncertain. This study described the clinical outcomes of an individualized staged management pathway for elderly patients with spinal TB in eastern China and reported outcomes of a clinically distinct cohort undergoing combined posterior and anterior surgery. No comparative efficacy hypothesis was tested.MethodsThis retrospective observational cohort study included patients treated between January 2020 and December 2022. Forty-two patients were classified according to treatment pathway. Group A comprised 23 patients managed with ultrasound-guided abscess drainage followed by posterior stabilization and posterolateral fusion, with anterior surgery reserved for inadequate infection control. Group B comprised 19 patients who underwent combined posterior and anterior surgery because immediate anterior debridement and/or interbody reconstruction were required. Because pathway selection was indication-based and the cohorts had different operative indications, outcomes were summarized descriptively rather than compared statistically. Index spinal operative time, index estimated blood loss, visual analog scale score, Oswestry Disability Index, kyphotic angle, Frankel grade, postoperative complications, and secondary surgery were recorded.ResultsAll patients achieved satisfactory clinical and radiographic outcomes during 24–45 months of follow-up. Mean index operative time was 211.26 ± 70.30 min in Group A and 315.68 ± 70.92 min in Group B, and mean index estimated blood loss was 406.52 ± 224.26 mL and 594.74 ± 139.33 mL, respectively. These values described different clinically selected index operations and were not statistically compared. At final follow-up, Frankel grade E was recorded in 19/23 (82.6%) patients in Group A and 16/19 (84.2%) in Group B, compared with 15/23 (65.2%) and 12/19 (63.2%) preoperatively. Recurrence occurred in one patient in Group A and three patients in Group B.ConclusionsThe individualized staged pathway was completed without salvage anterior surgery in 22 of 23 Group A patients, while one patient required subsequent anterior debridement and interbody fusion. These descriptive data support feasibility in selected patients but do not establish that preoperative catheter drainage is necessary or superior to posterior surgery without drainage. Combined posterior-and-anterior surgery remained appropriate when immediate anterior debridement or reconstruction was indicated.

title: ‘At school, I’m a teacher – with Auckland, I’m a teammate’
content:
When Eloise Blackwell debuted for the Auckland Storm rugby team in 2009, current teammate Emacyn Ieremia wasn’t even born.
And Ieremia isn’t just a teammate – she is a student at a school where ‘Mrs Blackwell’ is on the teaching staff.
Blackwell teaches and coaches Ieremia at Epsom Girls’ Grammar School, which won its maiden Auckland First XV championship this year.
On Saturday, Blackwell’s extraordinary longevity will be highlighted when she celebrates her 100th game for Auckland in the fourth round of the Dame Farah Palmer Cup (FPC) against Bay of Plenty at Eden Park.
Blackwell is just the second Auckland woman behind Fiao’o Fa’amausili (ONZM) to reach a century of appearances since the team’s inception in 1987. In 2017, Blackwell and Fa’amausili won a Rugby World Cup together as Black Ferns – the highlight of Blackwell’s 46 test international career that stretched from 2011 to 2021.
“It’s crazy to think I’ve been around as long as some of my teammates have been alive,” Blackwell laughed.
“A hundred games was never something I thought about or talked about, so to suddenly join Fi as the only one to do it is amazing. She’s a great player; she went to five Rugby World Cups.
“The teacher-student dynamic is interesting but balanced with a clear understanding that at school I’m a teacher; with Auckland I’m a teammate. The way I interact as a teammate might differ from how I interact in class, but respect and care still apply.
“Why do I keep going? I still believe I have something to offer. I’m keen to share what I know with those coming through. When I started, I was lucky that the Black Ferns were a regular part of the NPC. I learned from legends like Victoria Heighway and Vita Dryden. If younger players can learn something from me, I’m useful. Of course, knowledge goes both ways. I’m still learning from them.”
Blackwell grew up on Great Barrier Island, where her family lived from 1865. She lived there until she was 13, moving away to study at Mercury Bay Area School in Whitianga because there was no secondary school on the island. She spent years 12 and 13 playing rugby in Canada.
She joined Ponsonby to play rugby and netball in 2008 and debuted for Auckland a year later in a 41-9 win against Manawatū. She laughs: “I got 20 minutes at the end. I didn’t do my job.”
Auckland routinely won the FPC at the start of Blackwell’s career, securing Premierships every year from 2011 to 2015. The arrival of Counties Manukau, North Harbour, Northland, and Bay of Plenty as FPC unions, with fewer Black Ferns involved due to professionalism, has diminished Auckland’s dominance.
Still, Blackwell, who has 71 wins and 23 tries for Auckland, was established as a regular Black Fern by 2011, sharing several Tests with longtime Auckland teammate Charmaine Smith.
Smith recalls: “When I first started playing rugby, I nearly broke my neck after being cleaned out at a ruck. It was my fault. I was in the wrong position because I was still learning. I remember reflecting on what happened and decided to learn the right techniques, especially around contact. Eloise made that easier. She’s precise and detailed in everything she does. She explains difficult things simply and, most importantly, has great patience,” Smith said.
Between 2017 and 2022 Canterbury won the FPC Premiership five times. In 2023, Blackwell and Auckland finally broke an eight-year title drought in Christchurch, with Blackwell scoring two tries in her favourite Auckland game, a 39-27 final win.
“I’ve always had a love-hate relationship with Canterbury. I love playing them; I hate losing to them. They have always been a big rival for Auckland. In ’23 we did something special by going down there and beating their Black Ferns-stacked side.
“When you look at our team – Braxton Sorensen-McGee, Katelyn Vaha’akolo, Patricia Maliepo, Sylvia Brunt, Maia Roos, Ma’ama Vaupulu, Liana Mikaele-Tu’u – these girls have gone on to achieve special things with the Blues and the Black Ferns. That FPC was their breakthrough.
“The FPC without Black Ferns does feel a little bit watered down from what it was, but it remains a pivotal stepping stone and development pathway. I’m really excited by the young talent coming through.”
Blackwell is not only helping nurture that talent at first-class level. In her day job as a physical education teacher at EGGS, she has also taken on the role of First XV coach. This year, as well as winning that Auckland title for the first time, Epsom finished third at the National Top Four, defeating Christchurch Girls’ High School, who had attended every tournament since 2018, in a playoff match.
“We’re not doing anything special like academies or recruiting. We’re just working hard and creating a good experience and culture for the girls. I guess women’s rugby has had a lot of positive publicity lately, which helps attract good players,” Blackwell said.
Epsom is not renowned as a rugby school, but Blackwell has patiently built a program that is growing in numbers and reputation. Emacyn Ieremia and Mikaya Tonga are in the Auckland FPC squad with Blackwell.
Auckland was humbled 36-19 by Canterbury in the opening round of this year’s tournament. Blackwell acknowledged the performance was “below par.” A 37-36 upset of defending champions Waikato was a perfect response. In a game with nine lead changes, a 76th-minute try by prop Glory Aiono earned Auckland maximum competition points. Last Saturday, Counties Manukau was dispatched 46-26, with Blackwell scoring a try.
“We’ve got an exciting game plan and a good mix of youth and experience. We’re learning to better balance the desire for all-out attack with more kicking and orthodox strategy. Our biggest weakness is making too many mistakes by trying to do too much,” she explained.
Few have done more for Ponsonby Rugby Club than Blackwell. She credits Ponsonby with her success. It cultivated her love of the game and taught her the importance of service, tradition, and hard work.
Blackwell has played 117 senior club games, winning four Coleman Shields. The first in 2020 broke a 28-year drought without the title. When the “Fillies” won in 2025, they joined Marist (1999-2001) as the only other club to win a hat-trick of Coleman Shields. Ponsonby scored at least six tries in every match, something none of their other 18 undefeated champion Premier teams, men or women, can claim. The 2025 Fillies also scored at least 30 points every time, another first for the club, and beat their main rivals comprehensively each time, never winning by fewer than 10 points.
Additionally, Blackwell is a recognised leader at all levels of the club. She has served on committees, volunteered countless hours, and organised holiday coaching programmes for girls aged 13-17. These are always fully booked and very successful.
In 2025, she became the 12th person to have the double distinction of Centurion and Life Member on her blazer pocket. The others are Percy Tetzlaff, Sir Bryan Williams, Trevor Paterson, Keith Nelson, Lin Colling, Murray Menzies, Jack Huch, Joe Stanley, Andy Haden, Grant McCurrach and Grant Rutherford. That group includes six All Blacks and one Manu Samoa representative.
Paul Neazor is one of New Zealand’s pre-eminent rugby historians. A proud Ponsonby stalwart, he’s written extensively about a club that has won 12 Auckland senior female championships and produced 24 Black Ferns, not to mention their 48 All Blacks and 52 senior men’s championships.
“I believe Eloise has been a trailblazer for the women’s game in this country, refusing to accept bit roles and second-class status in what was a pretty macho world when she first started making her way in the game,” Neazor said.
“Her efforts have gone a long way to building not just the club’s strengths but also Auckland and the Black Ferns. Blackwell is a real student of lineout play and therefore a dominant figure in this area. She does all that is expected in the tight, and covers the ground surprisingly quickly in broken play. Seldom stood down unless injured, she has been one of the key players in the New Zealand game.”

title: Gossas : Clôture des 72H de l'Emploi, le Gouvernement réaffirme son engagement auprès des jeunes et des femmes

Gossas : Clôture des 72H de l'Emploi, le Gouvernement réaffirme son engagement auprès des jeunes et des femmes
Présidant ce lundi 21 septembre 2026 la cérémonie de clôture des « 72H de l’Emploi et de la Formation professionnelle et technique » dans la commune de Gossas, le ministre Idrissa Samb s'est félicité des résultats obtenus sur le terrain. Accompagné de Marie Angélique Diouf, ministre de la Famille et des Solidarités, ainsi que des autorités locales, il a réaffirmé sa conviction que « l’accès à l’emploi et aux compétences doit se faire au plus près des réalités territoriales ».
Portée par la Direction de l'Emploi et le 3FPT, cette initiative s'est traduite par des actions directes en faveur des jeunes, des femmes et des entreprises de la localité. Lors de ces trois jours de mobilisation, les équipes n'ont « pas seulement dialogué : elles ont agi ». Le bilan affiche notamment « 167 demandeurs d’emploi profilés et orientés », « 51 entreprises prospectées », dont « 14 entreprises d'ores et déjà enrôlées dans la Convention Nationale État-Employeurs (CNEE) ».
L'autonomisation des femmes et l'insertion des jeunes ont également occupé une place centrale avec « 800 femmes formées », « 20 GIE financés, bénéficiant directement à un ensemble de 300 femmes », et « 107 ASC touchées à l’échelle du département grâce au déploiement du programme “1 ASC, 1 métier” ».
L'événement s'est achevé par la mise en place d'une structure pérenne : « une Mission locale pérenne, installée pour faire vivre cet élan au quotidien ». Ce nouveau guichet de proximité a été pensé pour « accueillir, guider et propulser nos jeunes demandeurs d’emploi ainsi que l'ensemble des porteurs de projets », dans le cadre d'un déploiement qui va se poursuivre sur tout le territoire national.

title: Enhancing therapeutic outcomes in degenerative lumbar disc disease: a retrospective study on combined autologous PRP injection and celecoxib therapy
content: ObjectiveTo investigate the therapeutic value of autologous platelet-rich plasma (PRP) injection in patients with degenerative lumbar disc disease (DLDD), and to evaluate its clinical efficacy in alleviating pain, improving lumbar function, modulating inflammatory responses, and enhancing quality of life.MethodsThis retrospective study included 112 DLDD patients treated at our hospital from April 2023 to February 2025. According to the treatment received, patients were divided into two groups. The control group (n = 56) received oral celecoxib, while the observation group (n = 56) received autologous PRP injection in addition to oral celecoxib. The two groups were compared regarding treatment efficacy, pain response [Visual Analog Scale (VAS)], lumbar function [Japanese Orthopedic Association score (JOA)], disability in daily activities [Oswestry Disability Index (ODI)], inflammatory markers [Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP), stromal cell-derived factor-1 (SDF-1)], and incidence of adverse reactions.ResultsThe observation group demonstrated significantly superior overall efficacy compared with the control group (total effective rate: 94.96% vs. 82.14%, P < 0.05). There were significant differences between groups, over time, and in group-time interaction for VAS, JOA, and ODI scores (P < 0.05). At 4 weeks after treatment, TLR4, TNF-α, hs-CRP, and SDF-1 levels in both groups decreased compared with baseline, with greater reductions in the observation group (P < 0.05). The incidence of adverse reactions was similar between groups (8.93% vs. 14.29%, P > 0.05).ConclusionCombining autologous PRP injection with oral celecoxib provides short-term pain relief, functional improvement, and reduction of inflammatory responses in DLDD patients without significantly increasing adverse reactions. However, longer follow-up is required to determine the durability of these effects and the long-term clinical value of PRP-based treatment.

title: „O kodėl ne?“: apie Hugo, autizmą ir gyvenimą, kurio teko išmokti iš naujo
content:
Dešimtmetis Hugo beveik nekalba. Su artimaisiais jis bendrauja gestais, žvilgsniu, elgesiu ir vos keliais žodžiais. Per daugelį metų šeima išmoko atpažinti nemažai šių ženklų, tačiau dalis berniuko pasaulio jiems vis dar lieka nepasiekiama. „Jeigu Hugo galėtų man atsakyti, labiausiai norėčiau sužinoti vieną dalyką – ar jam su mumis gera“, – sako autizmo spektro sutrikimą turinčio berniuko tėtis Danielius Žamoit.
Vilniaus centre „Lietaus vaikai“ šviesu. Baltos sienos, piešiniai, už lango – sodas. Čia yra ką paliesti, ką pauostyti. Stovi ir nedidelis šiltnamis – pavasarį jo augalus sodino patys centro auklėtiniai. Būtent čia susitinkame su Danieliumi Žamoit ir jo sūnumi Hugo.
Berniuko akys didelės, gražios. Jis žiūri atidžiai. Po akimirkos ima tyliai leisti melodingus garsus – tarsi niūniuotų ką tik girdėtą melodiją. Žodžių beveik nevartoja.
Klausiu Danieliaus, koks yra jo sūnus.
„Mėgsta prisiglausti“, – trumpai atsako Danielius ir akimirkai nutyla.
„Jis labai mėgsta apkabinimus, jam svarbus prisilietimas. Jaučiame, kad taip jis parodo savo meilę“, – po pauzės priduria tėtis.
Hugo – berniukas, kurį reikia išmokti suprasti
Hugo dešimt metų, jis mokosi ketvirtoje klasėje.
Šeima puikiai atpažįsta jo „taip“. Kartais šį žodį berniukas net ištaria. Savąjį „ne“ jis taip pat turi – šis žodis skamba kiek kitaip nei mūsiškis, tačiau artimiesiems jo prasmė visiškai aiški.
Kur kas sudėtingiau yra visa tai, kas telpa tarp šių dviejų atsakymų.
Danielius pasakoja apie jų keliones automobiliu. Įjungia radiją, perjungia vieną stotį, kitą, dar kitą. Staiga Hugo sureaguoja. Tėčiui jau aišku, ką tai reiškia: grįžk prie ankstesnės dainos.
„Negalėčiau pasakyti, kokią muziką jis mėgsta labiausiai. Bet matau, kada jam kas nors patinka“, – pasakoja Danielius.
Jis taip pat žino, kada garsų sūnui pasidaro per daug, – tuomet Hugo delnais užsidengia ausis. Žino, kad berniukui patinka žmonės, kad jis noriai būna tarp jų, stebi į jį besikreipiantį žmogų.
Tačiau kur tiksliai yra jo supratimo ribos? Čia net tėvai žodžius renkasi atsargiai.
„Su žmona manome, kad kai ką jis supranta, kai į jį kreipiamasi. Paprastus nurodymus gali įvykdyti, tik ne visada iš karto“, – aiškina tėtis.
Namuose šeima kalba lenkiškai, o mokykloje ir dienos centre Hugo aplinka lietuviakalbė.
Dviratis, kuriuo, atrodė, jis taip ir nevažiuos
Kai Hugo buvo trejų, tėvai nupirko jam dviratuką. Bandė parodyti, kam skirti pedalai, kaip juos minti, kada stabdyti. Berniukui visa tai atrodė pernelyg sudėtinga – jis nesuprato pačios važiavimo logikos. Galiausiai tėvai nusprendė nebespausti. Nenorėjo jam kelti streso, o ir patys pamažu prarado viltį, kad dar verta bandyti.
Praėjo keleri metai.
Neseniai šeima svečiavosi pas draugus. Kieme stovėjo jų vaikų dviratis. Hugo tiesiog atsisėdo. Ir nuvažiavo.
Ne metrą ir ne du. Išlaikė pusiausvyrą, apvažiavo kliūtis, apsisuko ir važiavo toliau.
„Žiūrėjome į jį taip, lyg jis būtų pats sumaniausias dviratininkas pasaulyje. Mums tai buvo labai jautri akimirka“, – prisimena Danielius.
Netrukus Hugo gavo nuosavą dviratį. Dabar jis važiuoja pirmyn, grįžta, suka ratus – tarsi tai būtų savaime suprantama.
Danielius šią istoriją pasakoja su neslepiamu džiaugsmu. Tačiau joje slypi ir tai, kas Hugo tėvus lydi jau daugelį metų – suvokimas, kad jie ne visada žino, kur iš tiesų yra jų sūnaus galimybių ribos.
Ir tuomet kyla klausimas, kurio tėvas pats garsiai neištaria: kiek dar tokių dalykų slypi Hugo? Kiek gebėjimų, minčių, sąsajų tėvai pamatys tik tada, kai sūnus atras būdą juos parodyti?
Diena, sudėliota iš paveikslėlių
Žamoitų namuose rytai turi nusistovėjusį ritmą. Pirmiausia – Hugo.
„Pažadinu jį, nunešu į vonią. Dar galiu pakelti, nors jis vis sunkesnis. Kartu valomės dantis, Hugo reikia pagalbos“, – pasakoja Danielius.
Tai svarbiau, nei gali pasirodyti iš pirmo žvilgsnio. Paprastas apsilankymas pas odontologą Hugo yra didelis iššūkis – dukart dantys jam buvo gydomi taikant bendrąją nejautrą.
„Apsirengti jis gali ir pats. Tik tai užtrunka labai ilgai“, – tęsia tėtis.
Tada ateina eilė knygelei. Spalvoti paveikslėliai padeda dieną sudėlioti į nuspėjamą seką: kur šiandien važiuosime, kas bus vėliau, ką valgysime.
„Jam svarbu žinoti, kas jo laukia“, – aiškina Danielius.
Tačiau ši knygelė nėra stebuklinga vertėja tarp Hugo ir jo šeimos. Ji pirmiausia padeda artimiesiems kalbėti su berniuku taip, kad jam būtų lengviau suprasti, kas vyksta ir kas vyks toliau.
Kur kas sunkiau ši komunikacija veikia priešinga kryptimi.
„Hugo ne visada parodo pirštu, ko nori. Savo norus jis išreiškia gana nedaug“, – sako Danielius.
Neseniai šeima pradėjo naudoti ir elektroninę komunikacijos sistemos versiją. Kol kas dar tik stebi, ar Hugo ją priims ir ar ji jam taps patogiu būdu bendrauti.
Rytais prie namų atvažiuoja mokyklinis autobusiukas. Ir tai yra svarbi nusistovėjusios dienotvarkės dalis.
Hugo mėgsta būtent taip vykti į Vilniaus „Šilo“ ugdymo centrą. Kai kartais tėtis nuveža jį automobiliu, berniukas akivaizdžiai nuliūsta. Į mokyklą juk važiuojama autobusiuku.
Dar prieš kelerius metus net paprastas išėjimas iš namų galėjo tapti didžiuliu išbandymu. Hugo nenorėdavo išeiti, o jei pavykdavo jį įsodinti į automobilį, vėliau nenorėdavo iš jo išlipti.
Šiandien jis keliauja noriai. Net lėktuvu.
Po pamokų Hugo dažnai atvyksta į „Lietaus vaikus“. Čia kartu su kitais ruošia maistą, dalyvauja įvairiose veiklose.
Jam patinka būti kartu ir turėti konkretų užsiėmimą. Su močiute, pavyzdžiui, jis mielai kabina skalbinius.
„Jei reikia padėti, jis pirmas. Tikras veiklos žmogus“, – šypsosi tėtis.
„Dar pradės kalbėti“
Pirmasis nerimas atsirado, kai Hugo dar nebuvo sukakę treji. Jis nekalbėjo, dažnai nubėgdavo, jam buvo sunku ilgiau išbūti vienoje vietoje. Artimieji ir draugai ėmė atsargiai siūlyti tėvams kreiptis į specialistus.
Kiti sakydavo: „Palaukite. Berniukai dažnai pradeda kalbėti vėliau.“
Tuo norėjosi tikėti.
Juk Hugo žiūrėdavo į akis, šypsodavosi. Danielius prisimena, kad iš pirmo žvilgsnio sūnaus elgesyje jis nematė nieko, kas būtų leidę nujausti, jog netrukus jų šeimos gyvenimas pasisuks visai kita kryptimi.
Tėvai gavo siuntimą pas specialistus. Tada prasidėjo laukimas, kol pavyks patekti į Vaiko raidos centrą.
Tuo pat metu Hugo pradėjo lankyti darželį. Pirmieji mėnesiai buvo labai sunkūs.
Jis nenorėdavo pasilikti, bėgdavo, verkdavo ar šaukdavo, neužmigdavo, kai ilsėdavosi kiti vaikai.
Tėvai jautė į save krypstančius žvilgsnius.
„Atrodė, kad darbuotojai galvoja: kokie čia tėvai? Neišmokė savo vaiko tinkamai elgtis“, – prisimena Danielius.
Vėliau prasidėjo išsamesni tyrimai. Danielius iki šiol prisimena pačias paprasčiausias užduotis: parodyk katę, parodyk šunį.
Hugo jų neatlikdavo.
„Visi mūsų lūkesčiai, kad jis dar pradės kalbėti, kad viskas kažkaip savaime susitvarkys, subyrėjo į mažus gabalėlius“, – prisimena Danielius.
Tada kilo ir kitas klausimas: „Kodėl jis? Kodėl mes?“
„Tokių egoistiškų minčių atsiranda“, – šiandien sako Danielius, nebandydamas pagražinti to laikotarpio.
Tyrimai patvirtino, kad Hugo turi autizmo spektro sutrikimą ir didelių sunkumų suprasdamas ir vartodamas kalbą.
Po diagnozės šeima grįžo namo su dar paprastesniu klausimu: ką daryti toliau?
Tėvas sako, kad labiausiai trūko žmogaus, kuris padėtų susigaudyti sistemoje – žingsnis po žingsnio paaiškintų, kokia pagalba priklauso, kur kreiptis, ko galima tikėtis. Tad visko teko ieškoti patiems.
Privatūs specialistai. Užsiėmimai namuose. Pagalba darželyje.
„Visa tai kainuoja milžiniškus pinigus“, – sako jis.
Tačiau diagnozė kai ką ir pakeitė.
Darželyje Hugo nustojo būti laikomas neklusniu vaiku, kurio tėvai esą nemoka jo auklėti. Į jį pradėta žiūrėti kaip į vaiką, kuriam reikia pagalbos ir kitokio požiūrio.
„Grupės mergaitės jį saugojo, auklėtojos padėdavo. Hugo tapo darželio žvaigžde“, – šypsodamasis prisimena Danielius.
Sunkiausia būdavo per darželio šventes. Kiti vaikai mokėsi dainelių, eilėraščių, lipdavo į sceną. Tėvai matė, kaip mėnuo po mėnesio jie išmoksta vis daugiau.
O Hugo kartais nenorėdavo net įžengti į salę.
„Žiūri, kaip auga ir tobulėja kiti vaikai, ir nežinai, ar tavo vaikas apskritai kada nors padarys tą pažangą“, – sako Danielius.
„O kodėl ne?“
Kelerius metus Danielius su žmona apie antrą vaiką nenorėjo net galvoti.
Kategoriškas „ne“. Per daug baimės, per daug nuovargio, per daug nežinomybės.
Sprendimui jie brendo trejus metus. Šiandien šeimoje auga ir trimetis Noe. Neseniai jis uždavė klausimą, apie kurį tėvai žinojo – anksčiau ar vėliau jis vis tiek nuskambės: „Kodėl Hugo nekalba?“
Noe dažniausiai užduoda žaidimo ritmą. Vyresnysis brolis būna šalia, stebi ir savaip įsitraukia.
„Mažasis mėgsta Hugo paerzinti“, – juokiasi Danielius.
Tačiau vos tėvai griežčiau sudrausmina Noe, Hugo iškart stoja brolio pusėn. Gina jį.
Kartais tėvų mintys nukrypsta ir gerokai toliau – į laiką, kai abu berniukai jau bus suaugę.
Tėvai pagalvoja ir apie tai, kad vieną dieną Hugo jaunesniajam broliui gali tapti ne tik broliu, bet ir atsakomybe.
„Tokių minčių ateina“, – prisipažįsta Danielius.
Tačiau šiandien šeima šių klausimų nesprendžia.
Pirmuosius ketverius ar penkerius Hugo gyvenimo metus Danielius su žmona beveik nemiegojo. Naktimis keisdavosi prie sūnaus, vienas kitam leisdami bent truputį pailsėti.
Šiandien Danielius kalba apie priėmimą. Ne kaip apie vieną didelį lūžį ar staigų susitaikymą, o veikiau kaip apie tai, kas ateina per daugybę paprastų dienų, kai pamažu išmoksti gyventi su tuo, ko negali pakeisti.
„Anksčiau klausdavau: kodėl mums? Dabar pats sau atsakau – o kodėl ne?“ – sako jis.
Lyginti nustojo. Beveik...
„Kartais vis tiek pagalvoju, koks jis galėtų būti“, – prisipažįsta Danielius.
Jis sako, kad sūnaus diagnozė pakeitė ir jį patį. Jau daug metų jiedu su žmona nevartoja alkoholio. Abu nori būti stiprūs, fiziškai pajėgūs ir kuo ilgiau išlikti sveiki.
„Suprantame, kad mažą vaiką tikriausiai turėsime visą gyvenimą. Noriu kuo ilgiau būti šiame pasaulyje ir būti naudingas Hugo“, – sako Danielius.
Vaikas, kurio išskirtinumo nesimato
Daugiausia nejaukių situacijų kyla tada, kai aplinkiniai nesupranta, su kuo susiduria. Iš pirmo žvilgsnio Hugo atrodo kaip bet kuris kitas dešimtmetis.
Nėra jokio išorinio ženklo, kuris paaiškintų, kodėl jis kartais elgiasi kitaip.
Bažnyčioje pasitaiko, kad kas nors tėvams pasako: „Nuraminkite vaiką.“
Šiandien Danielius apie tokius atvejus kalba be pykčio. Galbūt todėl, kad gerai prisimena save patį prieš daugelį metų.
Dar prieš gimstant Hugo, į jų bažnyčią ateidavo šeima su raidos sutrikimų turinčiu vaiku. Danielius žiūrėdavo į juos ir galvodavo, kaip jiems turbūt sunku.
O tada pats save ramindavo viena mintimi: man taip nenutiks.
Po kurio laiko ta šeima į tą bažnyčią eiti nustojo.
Su žmona jie pastebi ir kitokią aplinkinių reakciją. Žmogus susipažįsta su Hugo, po kurio laiko supranta, kad berniukas kitoks, ir staiga sutrinka – nebežino, ką pasakyti, kaip elgtis.
Paguosti? Paklausti? O gal apsimesti, kad nieko nepastebėjo?
„Mes matome tą žmonių sutrikimą. Dabar kartais jis mus net prajuokina“, – sako Danielius.
Hugo tėvai sąmoningai pasirinko specializuotą ugdymo įstaigą.
Danielius neslepia įtraukiojo ugdymo galimybę vaikams, turintiems didelių specialiųjų ugdymosi poreikių, vertinantis gana skeptiškai. Šeima aplankė ir bendrojo ugdymo mokyklas, tačiau galiausiai nusprendė, kad jų sūnui labiau tinka kita aplinka.
„Norėjome pasirinkti vietą, kurioje sąlygos būtų kuo geriau pritaikytos Hugo poreikiams. Čia tokiems vaikams apgalvota viskas – net mokyklos skambutis ir autobusiukas“, – sako Danielius.
„Ar jam su mumis gera?“
Apie ateitį Danielius stengiasi negalvoti pernelyg toli į priekį.
„Tolimų planų nekuriame. Dabar yra mokykla, o kas bus vėliau – žiūrėsime“, – sako jis.
Tėvai mato, kad šiandien Hugo pasaulį supranta geriau nei prieš kelerius metus. Tačiau kalbos vis dar nėra.
Žinoma, jie norėtų, kad ji atsirastų. Tėvams svarbu ne pats žodžių tarimas – jie norėtų sąmoningo pokalbio, galimybės išgirsti sūnaus atsakymą.
Pokalbio pabaigoje klausiu, ką jis labiausiai norėtų sužinoti iš Hugo, jei sūnus galėtų jam atsakyti.
Danielius neatsako iš karto.
Po akimirkos ištaria: „Ar jam su mumis gera?“
Ir dar: „Ar viską darome teisingai?“
Baseinas. Žirgai. Užsiėmimai su šunimis. Specialistai. Mokykla. Vis naujos veiklos ir bandymai. Jau dešimt metų tėvai stengiasi Hugo suteikti kuo daugiau.
O Danielius kartais susimąsto, ar tame nuolatiniame siekyje Hugo duoti „kuo daugiau“ nėra ir kažko, ko sūnus tiesiog negali jiems pasakyti.
D. Žamoit sako, kad nors tolimos ateities jie neplanuoja, apie artimiausią – šiek tiek pagalvoja.
Sūnūs jau turi dviračius.
Kitais metais du dviračius sau ketina įsigyti ir tėvai. Kad visi keturi galėtų kur nors išvažiuoti kartu.
„Žinau, kad mums pavyks. Tai bus mūsų mažas bendras šeimos nuotykis“, – sako Danielius Žamoit.

title: Počinje isplata 6.000 dinara: Ko danas dobija novac, a ko mora da sačeka do sutra
content:
Isplata jednokratne pomoći od 6.000 dinara biće sprovedena tokom četiri dana, a trebalo bi da bude završena u petak. Ko novac dobija danas, ko od 23. septembra i ko nije morao da se prijavi?
Isplata jednokratne pomoći od 6.000 dinara počinje danas, 22. septembra, a novac će građanima biti uplaćivan u naredna četiri dana. Prvi na redu su građani koji pravo ostvaruju preko Akcionarskog fonda, kao i penzioneri i korisnici novčane socijalne pomoći, dok će oni koji su se za pomoć prijavljivali preko portala Uprave za trezor novac početi da dobijaju od srede.
Prema podacima Banke Poštanska štedionica, danas će biti obuhvaćeno oko 4,3 miliona građana koji pravo ostvaruju preko Akcionarskog fonda, kao i oko 575.000 ljudi koji pravo na pomoć ostvaruju po zakonu, a nisu imali obavezu da se prijavljuju.
Do ponoći 21. septembra za pomoć od 6.000 dinara prijavilo se oko 1,7 miliona građana.
Isplata u naredna četiri dana
Prema planu isplate, u sredu, 23. septembra, novac će biti uplaćen za gotovo milion građana koji su se prijavljivali za pomoć.
Za četvrtak, 24. septembar, predviđena je isplata za još oko 500.000 ljudi, među kojima su građani koji su se prijavili poslednjeg dana roka.
Isplata bi trebalo da bude završena u petak, 25. septembra.
Punoletni građani koji nisu nosioci prava po osnovu besplatnih akcija, a koji su se prijavili preko portala Uprave za trezor, pomoć dobijaju u okviru ovog ciklusa isplate.
Penzioneri, korisnici novčane socijalne pomoći i određene druge kategorije građana obuhvaćene zakonom nisu morali da podnose prijavu za 6.000 dinara.
Njima se novac uplaćuje na osnovu podataka iz državnih evidencija.
Automatska isplata predviđena je i za lica koja se nalaze u zavodima za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija.
Pravo na novac imaju i naslednici preminulih građana koji su imali besplatne akcije. Za isplatu je potrebno pravosnažno rešenje o nasleđivanju i važeća lična karta, dok se novac isplaćuje preko Banke Poštanska štedionica.
Koliko dugo može da se podigne novac
Za građane koji pomoć ostvaruju iz Akcionarskog fonda ne postoji rok za podizanje novca.
Kod građana koji 6.000 dinara dobijaju iz državnog budžeta, novac će biti moguće podići u roku od godinu dana.
Građanima koji nemaju račun u banci za ovu namenu biće otvoren račun u Banci Poštanska štedionica.
Šta je potrebno za prijavu
Građani koji su morali da se prijave za pomoć svoj status su mogli da provere i prijavu podnesu preko portala Uprave za trezor.
Prilikom provere bilo je potrebno uneti matični broj i broj lične karte. Rok za prijavljivanje istekao je 21. septembra u ponoć.
Jednokratna pomoć od 6.000 dinara deo je šireg paketa državne pomoći koji, prema podacima Ministarstva finansija, obuhvata različite kategorije građana i ukupno je vredan gotovo milijardu evra.

title: Rwanda: Bralirwa's New Social Impact Initiative Brings Safe Water to Over 200 Households in Nyarugenge
content:
More than 200 households in Nyarugenge District are set to gain access to safe and reliable water in their homes under a social impact initiative launched by BRALIRWA Plc, part of the HEINEKEN Company, in partnership with Water Access Rwanda, benefiting more than 1,000 people.
The initiative was officially commissioned on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, in Nyamirambo Sector, Nyarugenge District, during an event that brought together representatives from the City of Kigali, Nyarugenge District, Water Access Rwanda, local leaders, community members, development partners, and beneficiaries.
The occasion marked the culmination of a partnership-driven effort to improve access to safe and reliable water for vulnerable households across four sectors of Nyarugenge District: Nyarugenge, Mageragere, Kanyinya and Kigali.
Beneficiaries were identified and validated through a collaborative process involving Water Access Rwanda and local authorities to ensure support reached households facing the greatest challenges in accessing clean water, BRALIRWA stated.

Speaking at the launch event, BRALIRWA Managing Director, Ethel Emma-Uche, said the initiative reflects the company's commitment to creating lasting impact through its Brew a Better World agenda.
"Social sustainability is one of the key pillars under our Brew a Better World agenda and an integral part of our Evergreen 2030 global strategy. Our ambition is to create lasting impact for people, communities we serve, and the environment through strategic partnerships, under our rallying cry 'Together We Can'," she said.
The Managing Director added that meaningful and sustainable progress is achieved when businesses, government institutions, development partners and communities work together to address shared challenges.
Vice Mayor of the City of Kigali in Charge of Socio-Economic Affairs, Martine Urujeni, who officiated the event, commended BRALIRWA and Water Access Rwanda for investing in solutions that directly improve the lives of vulnerable households.
She noted that improved access to safe water will help families save time and effort previously spent fetching water, while contributing to better health, hygiene and living conditions.
The company aligns its social impact projects to global and national development priorities such as the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals as well as the Second National Strategy for Transformation (NST2) where access to clean water is key to sustainable development.
The company previously supported 100 young mothers from underserved communities in Gatsibo and Rwamagana District to receive business start-up kits to enhance their economic opportunities in partnership with Empower Rwanda. It also supported 250 households in Rwamagana district to have access to safe drinking water through donation of ceramic water filters in partnership with Spouts of Water Rwanda.

title: Gaza students return to in-person schooling
content:
Hundreds of thousands of children in Gaza returned to in-person teaching for the first time in nearly three years, albeit in damaged or makeshift school buildings and tents, and with uniforms, notebooks and pens unaffordable for many families.
The United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) says 98% of schools in Gaza were either destroyed or damaged during the war, and Gaza education officials say about 660,000 students have been deprived of in-person learning and regular participation in education.
The reopening on Saturday is a fragile milestone for Gaza after a conflict that has killed around 22,000 students and more than 770 education workers, including 532 teachers, according to the director of education for East Khan Younis.
"The last time I have been to school was three years ago. Now, we are starting the school year, it is year of joy, happiness and success," said one student in Khan Younis.
Another boy said he was determined to learn even though he will sit on the floor in a tent lacking ventilation, he has no decent shoes, nor a notebook and pen, and lost friends during the war.
"Despite all of this we will learn, we will learn even in a tent."
Fifteen-year-old displaced student Samar Abu Salmi, who lives with her family in a tent, is also returning to class.
"We studied on phones and we haven't seen our teachers...now, we are back pursuing our dream... from one tent to another," she said, speaking in the yard of her new makeshift school.
She also lacks much of the essential equipment, which has become unaffordable for her family.
"Before the war, everything was available for us - notebooks, pens, goods, clothes, outings, things that we could get cheaply," Salmi said.
Despite the devastation in Gaza, the Ministry of Education, backed by international and local organisations, has moved ahead with the 2026-27 academic year, establishing dozens of temporary schools made of tents, tarpaulins, sheet metal and wood to accommodate pupils.
Some are built on sandy ground, others have classrooms with only some mattresses and a blackboard, into which students cram. Others are still housing dozens of displaced families.
At least 540,000 students are expected to attend in-person classes this year in makeshift private schools, temporary learning centres and educational points, with UNICEF support, according to education officials.
Online learning will continue for those who cannot attend classes or who left Gaza during the war.

title: Mike Hammer Engages with Families Receiving Humanitarian Aid in Villa Clara
content:
Mike Hammer, the chief of mission at the U.S. Embassy in Cuba, visited the municipality of Corralillo in Villa Clara this past weekend, particularly the town of Quintín Banderas. His visit aimed to connect with families who benefited from U.S. humanitarian aid packages and ensure the assistance reached those in dire need.
The Embassy captured Hammer's visit in a video shared on its X account, under the hashtag #ConCubanosDeAPie. The footage shows Hammer engaging in conversations with the aid recipients inside their homes.
The visuals highlighted the precarious conditions these families face daily. One woman expressed her gratitude to Hammer upon receiving the aid, saying, "I cried so much. The need is overwhelming," and mentioned that before receiving the package, she had nothing left to eat. Another recipient shared her experience trying the sardines included in the food module.
"Being close to Cubans and listening to them is fundamental to our work," the Embassy noted when posting the video, appreciating the families for "opening their homes and welcoming us warmly."
Follow-Up on Aid Distribution in Villa Clara
This visit was a direct follow-up to the distribution that began in Villa Clara on September 10, when 700 food kits and 700 hygiene kits arrived at Abel Santamaría Airport, targeted for families in Quemado de Güines and Rancho Veloz.
Hammer had previously toured the province from September 12 to 14, visiting vulnerable households in Quemado de Güines and the Cotorra neighborhood. He also met with Bishop Arturo González Amador, the director of Cáritas Santa Clara, and dissident Guillermo "Coco" Fariñas, who had been detained on August 31.
Challenges and Future Aid Plans
During that visit, the Cuban regime launched a disinformation campaign against Hammer in Villa Clara, falsely claiming the food was contaminated—a claim publicly refuted by Cáritas.
The aid Hammer oversees is part of a $100 million program announced by the Trump administration for Cuba. Of this, $60 million is directed through the Catholic Church via Cáritas Cuba and Catholic Relief Services, while $40 million is channeled through other independent organizations, bypassing the Cuban state.
On September 16, the Embassy revealed plans to extend aid to five additional provinces: Camagüey, Ciego de Ávila, Cienfuegos, Matanzas, and Pinar del Río. Shortly thereafter, Cáritas Cienfuegos distributed nearly 700 kits in the Lajas municipality.
Scope and Limitations of the Aid Program
The program is expected to benefit between 100,000 and 120,000 families across Cuba, prioritizing elderly individuals living alone, people with disabilities, pregnant or nursing women, and families with children under five.
Bishop González Amador has cautioned, however, that the assistance has clear limitations: "We can only help the most urgent and distressing cases," stressing that "this is not a permanent social assistance project."
Frequently Asked Questions About U.S. Humanitarian Aid in Cuba
What is the goal of Mike Hammer's visit to Villa Clara?
Mike Hammer's visit aimed to ensure that U.S. humanitarian aid reached those in need and to engage with the families who benefited from the aid packages.
How was the aid distributed across Cuba?
The aid is part of a $100 million program, with $60 million distributed through the Catholic Church and $40 million through other independent organizations, prioritizing vulnerable groups throughout the island.
What challenges have been faced during the aid distribution?
The Cuban regime attempted a disinformation campaign claiming the food was contaminated, which was publicly refuted by Cáritas.

title: Insula Lacul Morii s-a redeschis. Cum arată noul parc din București și ce facilități au fost amenajate
content:
Foto Insula Lacul Morii s-a redeschis. Cum arată noul parc din București și ce facilități au fost amenajate
Bucureștenii au din nou acces pe Insula Lacul Morii, care a fost redeschisă vineri după finalizarea lucrărilor de modernizare. Zona a fost amenajată ca spațiu pentru plimbare, relaxare, sport și evenimente de mici dimensiuni, iar autoritățile pregătesc și extinderea proiectului cu un parc liniar de aproximativ doi kilometri.
Anunțul a fost făcut de primarul general al Capitalei, Ciprian Ciucu, care a precizat că lucrările au vizat atât insula, cât și digul din apropiere.
„Insula Lacul Morii s-a redeschis astăzi, transformată, bucureștenilor. După ce am refăcut digul, după ce am refăcut Insula, urmează să facem acolo și un mare parc liniar de 2 kilometri. E un sentiment frumos, de împlinire, după ani de pregătire și muncă”, a transmis edilul.
Potrivit autorităților, insula are o suprafață de aproximativ 3,4 hectare, dintre care 2,3 hectare sunt destinate spațiilor verzi. Proiectul include alei, zone de odihnă și locuri în care vizitatorii se pot apropia de apă.
Ciprian Ciucu a anunțat că pe insulă există mai multă umbră, iar vegetația urmează să se dezvolte în următorii ani.
„Aveți acces la apă, mai multă umbră, vegetația va crește, se poate face plajă, se pot face evenimente publice de mici dimensiuni. Sper să vă placă și să o păstrați”, a spus primarul general.
Amenajarea face parte dintr-un proiect mai amplu de regenerare urbană a zonei Lacul Morii, care urmărește transformarea spațiului într-o zonă de agrement și recreere pentru locuitorii Capitalei.
Săptămâna trecută, premierul interimar Ilie Bolojan afirma că investiția are ca obiectiv transformarea terenului neutilizat într-un parc urban modern, cu spații verzi, zone de promenadă și locuri pentru activități sportive.
„Este un proiect care transformă 3,4 hectare de teren neutilizat într-un parc urban modern, cu 2,3 hectare de spațiu verde, în intravilanul Capitalei”, a transmis Bolojan.
El a precizat că investiția este realizată cu fonduri europene, naționale și bani alocați de Sectorul 6, valoarea totală menționată fiind de aproape 59 de milioane de lei.
„Nu e doar despre un lac reamenajat. E despre calitatea vieții oamenilor: un loc de plimbare sigur, un loc pentru sport, o gură de aer proaspăt în mijlocul orașului”, a mai spus premierul interimar.
Modernizarea insulei reprezintă prima etapă a proiectului dedicat zonei Lacul Morii. Autoritățile urmează să continue lucrările pentru amenajarea parcului liniar, care va avea o lungime de aproximativ doi kilometri.

title: Men incarcerated in Kansas heard families owed $6,000 for lunch, raised funds to help
content:
A group of men incarcerated in Kansas saw a problem in their community and stepped in with money from their own pockets to help solve it.
After learning that Norton Community Schools had accumulated roughly $6,000 in unpaid meal costs, they organized a fundraiser that erased most of the debt.
Here's what to know
On Aug. 3, nearly 30 men incarcerated at Norton Correctional Facility gathered to present Superintendent Corey Roy with a check for $4,267 to put toward the district's unpaid meal accounts.
As local news outlet KWCH reported, an effort to raise the funds was organized through Reaching Out from Within, an organization that has been operating in prisons across Kansas, North Carolina, and Missouri for over four decades to enable member-led healing and rehabilitation.
In the recent Norton fundraiser, individuals participating in the program donated $3,810, and staff from the Kansas Department of Corrections contributed another $457, according to KWCH. With that gift, the district was able to clear the majority of its meal debt, which built up as the school provided breakfasts and lunches to students experiencing food insecurity at home.
More background
A statement shared by the correctional facility noted that many of the men who had donated said they had gone hungry when they were young and believed it had hurt their performance in school. They hoped their efforts would help to ensure that food insecurity would not be a barrier for students as they began the new academic year.
"I was moved at how the men I spoke with wanted to make a positive impact to help others in the community," Roy also said in the statement.
As economic pressures, compounded by energy shocks and hits to agricultural production, contribute to rising food costs across the country, more families are experiencing the strain at home.
At the same time, more than 1.5 million children — and around 5 million people overall — are estimated to have lost access to support through the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or SNAP, since the One Big Beautiful Bill Act became law in 2025. The estimates were published by the Center on Budget and Policy Priorities last month.
Families could feel even more pressure related to the loss of federal benefits by the end of September, when many SNAP program costs are set to shift to states.
No nationwide solution for school meal debt has yet passed Congress. Many districts still rely on local responses such as donations, nonprofit partnerships, and direct aid for families.

title: BASF, Petrovietnam Ca Mau Fertilizer Corporation, Dong Thap authorities help 200 farmers adopt low-emission rice farming
content:
BASF Starting Ventures, Petrovietnam Ca Mau Fertilizer Corporation (PVCFC, a member of Petrovietnam), and the local authorities, including the Department of Agriculture and Environment of Dong Thap Province, Sub-Department of Plant Production and Protection of Dong Thap Province, and People's Committees of Phong My Commune and Truong Xuan Commune, on Thursday announced a joint initiative to support a total of 200 smallholder farmers from four cooperatives.
Through four training and field demonstration sessions in 2026, participating farmers will receive practical guidance on climate-resilient rice farming.
The project will also provide the four cooperatives with straw balers to collect and reuse rice straw after harvest instead of burning, and Alternating Wet-Dry Irrigation Water Management (AWD) facilities, a water-saving technology that farmers can apply to reduce their irrigation water consumption in rice fields without compromising its yield, helping farmers use water more efficiently and with lower emissions.
The beneficiaries include Truong Thanh Agricultural Cooperative, Truong Phat Cooperative, Agricultural Cooperative No. 2 Gao Giong, and Thuan Tien Agricultural Cooperative.
"By helping farmers adopt more efficient ways of using natural resources, reduce field burning, and make better use of straw by-products, this project can create positive impact for both local communities and the environment," said Erick Contreras, managing director at BASF Vietnam, which provides innovative chemical and material solutions.
"Together with our partners, BASF is pleased to strengthen cooperation across the agricultural value chain and contribute to the sustainable development of the Mekong Delta's rice sector."
Dong Thap, located in the heart of the Mekong Delta, is one of Vietnam's key rice producing regions.
Supported by extensive agricultural land, a well-developed irrigation network, and long-standing farming experience, agriculture, especially rice production, has been a key industry of the province.
In recent years, Dong Thap Province has advanced its rice sector toward more sustainable and high-quality production while reducing farming costs.
At the same time, the province has developed dedicated production areas and enhanced food safety measures to meet the requirements of domestic and international markets.
The majority of farmers, cooperatives, and enterprises in the province have actively applied advanced technologies and sustainable farming practices, thus better meeting stringent requirements of the markets.
Despite this progress, the local rice growers, especially those in Truong Xuan Commune and Phong My Commune continue to face significant challenges.
These include extreme weather conditions, high prices of materials and labor, market price fluctuations, technical barriers, and increasingly stringent requirements of food safety, traceability, emission reduction, and post-harvest straw management.
"Through this project, we aim to equip farmers with practical knowledge and tools to adopt low-emission rice farming, manage water more efficiently, make better use of rice straw by-products, and build stronger linkages across the rice value chain," Contreras said.
"In doing so, we hope to support the sector's transition toward more sustainable, high-quality rice production."
